limitations_and_boundaries: Absence of age-matched wild-type control mice.
Incomplete C3 deficiency in the brain (not complete knockout).
Global C3 lowering may not be safe long-term in humans due to infection risk; brain-specific targeting may be preferable.

missed_core_items.description: C1q levels in brain were significantly reduced in TAM-treated mice (ELISA p=0.04; immunofluorescence p=0.0392).
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Brain C1q levels were significantly decreased (p = 0.04) by ELISA in TAM-treated APP;C3iKO mice compared to CO-treated control mice (Fig. 3D). C1q immunofluorescent staining demonstrated a significantly lower mean fluorescence intensity in the hippocampus of TAM-treated APP;C3iKO mice compared to CO-treated mice, indicating a significant reduction (p = 0.0392) in C1q levels in the brains of TAM-treated mice (Fig. 3E and F).

missed_core_items.description: Plaque-associated GFAP-positive astrocytes were significantly reduced in TAM-treated mice (p=0.0373).
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: The density of GFAP-positive astrocytes surrounding amyloid plaques in the hippocampus was significantly reduced (P = 0.0373) in TAM-injected mice (Fig. 6E).

missed_core_items.description: qPCR results: TNFα mRNA significantly reduced (p=0.0192), IL-10 mRNA significantly reduced (p=0.015), CX3CR1 mRNA significantly reduced (p=0.0345), and IL-6 showed a strong trend for reduction (p=0.065).
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: The mRNA expression levels of proinflammatory and anti-inflammatory cytokines TNFα (p = 0.0192) and IL-10 (p = 0.015), respectively, were significantly reduced in TAM-treated APP;C3iKO mice (Fig. 7E & I). ... pro-inflammatory IL-6 mRNA levels showed a strong, but non-significant trend for reduction in TAM-treated mice (p = 0.065; Fig. 7F). ... TAM-injected APP;C3iKO mice showed markedly reduced CX3CR1 mRNA, a chemokine receptor (p = 0.0345; Fig. 7H).

missed_core_items.description: C3 lowering had no effect on overall GFAP immunoreactivity in hippocampus.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: No significant differences were observed in hippocampal GFAP immunoreactivity (Fig. 4F-J).

missed_core_items.description: C3 lowering had no effect on insoluble Aβ levels measured by ELISA.
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Insoluble Aβ levels in the GuHCl brain homogenates were quantified by ELISA. Similar to the pathological data, there was no significant difference in insoluble Aβ levels between TAM- and CO-treated APP;C3iKO mice (Fig. 5C).
